name.description: Spine name — writes <name>.memory.ts / <name>.worker.ts / <name>.ts under the atoll dir.

project.description: Nx project to wire — the spine lands under its sourceRoot/atoll. Omit for the workspace root.

framework.description: Framework override — the workspace root package.json may not describe the target project.

install.description: Offer to install the @atolljs/* deps the framework needs (false → --no-install).
